description: Dropdown menu of actions on a trigger -- overflow, more actions, context.

trigger.description: The element that opens the menu. The consumer draws it -- an ArenaIconButton with ph-dots-three-vertical, a secondary ArenaButton -- so it is a slot, and it carries its own accessible name.

items.description: The entries, in order: activatable rows, dividers and group headers.

align.description: Which edge of the trigger the panel lines up with.

select.description: An entry was activated; carries the whole item. A disabled entry reports nothing, and a divider or a header cannot be activated at all.
